mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: Caelan! That dreadful wheel's finally stopped altogether.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: You said it was making a noise.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: And now it isn't making any noise. That's worse!

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Did you ask Mira to look at it?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: That's why I'm here. Someone fetch her before festival flour becomes festival dust.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Then be careful along the channel.
